description: Add the imperative-shell integration test suite using wiremock as a LOCAL fake for api.etrade.com (no live ETrade calls — AC-13), covering the OAuth three-leg flow, the proxy forward with the structural GET-only guarantee end-to-end, /internal/status over the real rustls stack in both auth phases (driving Pending via the serve seam, which also exercises the 503/NotReady branch), nonce-freshness across sequential requests, and the rcgen->fingerprint integration. Then run the full verification gate (cargo build, cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test) in the workspace root and confirm it is green. Depends on FEAT-002 (needs the shell's serve/oauth_flow seams and injected generators).
steps: tests/oauth_flow.rs: stand up a wiremock server for the two OAuth legs; drive shell::oauth_flow::run against it with deterministic fake Clock/NonceSource and assert an Authorized is produced, the recorded request-token call's signature base string contains oauth_callback=oob, the access-token call's contains oauth_verifier=<code>, and the two legs carry DISTINCT oauth_nonce values. No live calls.

tests/proxy_forward.rs: construct the server with an Authorized (Ready) state via the serve seam pointed at a wiremock upstream; assert GET /etrade-api/v1/accounts/list?x=1 reaches the fake as GET /v1/accounts/list?x=1 with the query preserved and a signed Authorization header; a POST to the same prefix returns 405 and the mock records ZERO upstream hits (structural GET-only, end-to-end); an out-of-prefix GET returns 404. With a counter-backed NonceSource injected via serve, two sequential proxied GETs carry distinct oauth_nonce values in the recorded upstream headers.

tests/status.rs: serve /internal/status over the real rustls stack; assert {"authorized":true} with a Ready state and {"authorized":false} with a Pending state (passing Pending directly into serve), and that the proxy handler returns 503/ProxyError::NotReady while Pending.
tests/tls.rs: assert rcgen produces a usable cert whose cert.der() the shell hashes into the exact lowercase colon-hex SHA-256 fingerprint format (consistent with the core tls_fingerprint vector).
Ensure no test depends on network access to the real ETrade API; all upstream/OAuth endpoints are wiremock. Commit any insta snapshots and proptest-regressions produced.
Run the full verification gate in /Users/paulbrown/Code/etrade-local-proxy and fix any failures until green.
acceptance_criteria: `cargo test` passes all unit, proptest, and integration tests (AC-3).
No automated test performs a live ETrade network call; OAuth exchange and upstream forward are covered against wiremock local fakes (AC-13).
An integration test proves a POST under the proxy prefix returns 405 and is NEVER forwarded upstream (zero mock hits).
An integration test proves /internal/status reports {"authorized":false} in Pending and {"authorized":true} in Ready (AC-10 end-to-end), and the proxy handler returns 503 while Pending.
An integration test proves two sequential proxied requests carry distinct oauth_nonce values (freshness contract).
findings:
COMPLETE and green. Full gate in /Users/paulbrown/Code/etrade-local-proxy: `cargo build` OK; `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` ZERO warnings; `cargo test` 110 passed / 0 failed (101 unit+proptest in src/lib.rs + 9 new integration tests). No live ETrade calls — every upstream/OAuth endpoint is a local wiremock server or the in-process axum router; the one real-rustls test talks only to its own loopback listener.

INTEGRATION SUITE ADDED under tests/:
- tests/common/mod.rs: shared helpers (has `#![allow(dead_code)]` since each integration binary compiles the module independently and does not use every helper). `test_config()` builds a Config from fixed non-secret creds; `parse_oauth_header()`/`oauth_param()` recover the signed (name,value) pairs from a recorded `Authorization: OAuth ...` header. NOTE: because the pure core builds the base string and the header from the SAME `OauthParams::as_pairs()`, asserting a param is present in the recorded header is equivalent to asserting it is in the signature base string — this is how the 'base string contains oauth_callback=oob / oauth_verifier' acceptance criteria are checked end-to-end (wiremock exposes the header, not the base string).
- tests/oauth_flow.rs (2 tests): drives `shell::oauth_flow::run` against a wiremock server for both legs with `FixedClock` + `CounterNonceSource`. Asserts an Authorized is produced (access_token==acctok); the recorded request-token call signs `oauth_callback=oob` and emits NO oauth_token; the access-token call signs `oauth_verifier=verifier-code` and oauth_token==reqtok; and the two legs' `oauth_nonce` values are DISTINCT. Second test: an empty verifier aborts with `OauthFlowError::EmptyVerifier` and never calls the (unmounted) access-token leg. Uses the ASYNC `server.received_requests().await` to read recorded headers (no `futures` dep needed).
- tests/proxy_forward.rs (4 tests): assembles the in-process router via `server::app_state(config, state::ready(...), clock, nonces, Some(server.uri()))` + `server::router(...)` and drives it with `tower::ServiceExt::oneshot` (added `tower = { version = "0.5", features = ["util"] }` dev-dep). (a) GET /etrade-api/v1/accounts/list?x=1 reaches the fake as GET /v1/accounts/list?x=1 (path+query preserved) with a signed `OAuth ` header carrying oauth_token=acctok, exactly 1 upstream hit; (b) POST under the prefix => 405 and ZERO upstream hits (structural GET-only, end-to-end, via a catch-all `any()` mock that would record any stray forward); (c) out-of-prefix GET => 404, zero hits; (d) two sequential GETs through a shared `CounterNonceSource` carry DISTINCT oauth_nonce values in the recorded upstream headers.
- tests/status.rs (2 tests): serves `/internal/status` over the REAL rustls stack through the `serve` seam. A free loopback port is grabbed by binding 127.0.0.1:0 then releasing it; `serve(ListenPort, tls.server_config, config, auth, SystemClock, RandomNonceSource)` is spawned as a tokio task and polled until listening; a reqwest client with `danger_accept_invalid_certs(true)` trusts the ephemeral self-signed cert. Pending state => body `{"authorized":false}` AND a proxied GET => 503 (ProxyError::NotReady, no upstream call attempted). Ready state => `{"authorized":true}`. Task handle aborted at end of each test.
- tests/tls.rs (1 test): `rcgen::generate_simple_self_signed(["127.0.0.1"])` produces a usable cert whose `cert.der()` the core `tls_fingerprint::fingerprint` renders as exactly 32 lowercase colon-hex octets; `shell::tls::generate()` yields the identical shape and the fingerprint is deterministic over the DER.

MANIFEST CHANGES: added dev-dep `tower = { version="0.5", features=["util"] }` for the in-process `oneshot` driver (Cargo.lock updated). No runtime deps added. No insta `.snap.new` and no proptest-regressions were produced (integration tests are example-based; no proptest failures), so there were no snapshot/regression artifacts to commit.

DECISIONS/NOTES: (1) The proxy-forward tests drive the router in-process rather than over TLS because `serve` hardcodes upstream_base=None (real host) — pointing the proxy at wiremock requires `app_state(..., Some(uri))`, exactly as FEAT-002's findings advised. (2) The real-rustls coverage lives in status.rs where no upstream is needed. (3) The Pending/503 branch is reached both in-process (not used) and over the serve seam in status.rs. (4) base-string assertions are made via the recorded Authorization header given the as_pairs() single-source-of-truth guarantee.
